chunks: And by this chain of transmission, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who said: Al-Mas'udi narrated to me. He said: Yahya ibn Salim al-'Abdi narrated to us from Isra'il, from Maysara, from al-Minhal ibn 'Amr, from Zirr ibn Hubaysh. He said:

'Ali (peace be upon him) passed by on the mule of the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) while Salman was in a gathering. Salman (may God's mercy be upon him) said: Will you not go and take him by his belt and ask him?

For by Him who split the seed and gave life to the soul, none will inform you of the secret of your Prophet (may God bless him and his family) except him. He is the scholar of the earth and its master, and it is to him that it settles. If you were to lose him, you would lose knowledge and no longer recognize the people.

key_terms.حُجْزَة: Belt/waistband — metaphor for holding fast to someone, clinging to them for guidance
key_terms.رَبَّانِيُّهَا: Its lord/master — a divinely appointed guide, one whose authority is of divine origin
key_terms.سِرُّ النَّبِيِّ: The secret of the Prophet — the esoteric knowledge, confidential teachings, and spiritual secrets entrusted to the Imam alone
key_terms.عَالِمُ الْأَرْضِ: Scholar of the earth — one who possesses comprehensive knowledge of all earthly affairs, both religious and cosmic

ai.seo_question: What did Salman al-Farisi say about Imam Ali's knowledge and status?
ai.summary: Zirr ibn Hubaysh narrates that Salman al-Farisi urged the companions to approach Imam Ali (AS) and ask him, swearing by the most solemn oath that Ali alone carries the secret knowledge of the Prophet (SAWW). Salman declares that Ali is the 'scholar of the earth and its master' (عالم الأرض وربانيها) — a title indicating his unique cosmic and spiritual authority — and warns that losing him would mean losing all religious knowledge. This hadith is part of the rich tradition in Shia sources affirming the unique religious authority and knowledge of Imam Ali, which was recognized even by close companions of the Prophet like Salman.

en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Al-Mas`udi narrated to me. He said: Yahya b. Salim al-`Abdi narrated to us from Isra’il from Maysara from al-Minhal b. `Amr from Zir b. Hubaysh. He said:
`Ali (as) passed by while mounted on mule of the Messenger of Allah (s) with Salman. So, Salman (rh) said: Will you not go to him and take him by his belt?

For, by Him who split the seed and gave life, none can inform you of the secret of your Prophet (s) except him. He is the scholar and the master of the Earth, and it settles due to him. If you lose him, you will have lost knowledge and negated the people.
